title: Fast-path replies for short greetings and social phrases (no LLM)

replies: Hello! Welcome. Table for how many, or would you like to order to go?

Good evening! Welcome to our restaurant. Do you have a reservation?

My pleasure! Let me know if you need anything else.
Thank you for dining with us. Have a wonderful evening!
Goodbye! We hope to see you again soon.
No worries at all. How can I help you?
